subject: FFIEC continuity & failover deep-dive — evidence package requested
messages:
From: Sarah Mellinger <sarah.mellinger@axiabank.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Tim Holt <tim.holt@axiabank.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: FFIEC continuity deep-dive — request for evidence and timelines

Jonas,

Thanks for the overview last week. As part of Axia's third-party continuity assessment (FFIEC-style), the vendor review team needs a focused evidence package and short answers to a handful of follow-ups before next Friday. Can you confirm the following and provide attachments where possible: 

- RTO and RPO targets for hosted (Redwood API) vs Dedicated pools vs Private/VPC deployments.
- Dates and results summary for the most recent full DR failover test and tabletop (we need logs or a short CSV of test results).
- Runbook excerpt showing automated failover steps and manual escalation points (redact IPs if needed).
- SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF and the date range covered.
- Key management: whether customer-managed KMS/HSM is supported, and evidence of encryption-at-rest configs for dedicated/private tenants.
- Data residency controls (regions supported and how routing/pinning is enforced).
- Third-party subprocessors list for any infra, telemetry, or monitoring tools touching production keys.

Deliverable timeline: can you provide this package within 10 business days (by 12 May)? If not, please propose an alternative schedule.

We appreciate concise artifacts (single-page summaries + attachments). If we can get a short mutual action plan / checklist, that would speed our internal review.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Mellinger
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
Axia Bank

Attachment: AXIA_FFIEC_Continuity_Request_04282026.pdf (request checklist)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Mellinger <sarah.mellinger@axiabank.com>, Tim Holt <tim.holt@axiabank.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FFIEC continuity deep-dive — request for evidence and timelines

Hi Sarah / Tim —

Thanks — we can absolutely compile a focused package. High level answers below and a proposed delivery plan. I will attach the SOC 2 Type II and an excerpt of the failover runbook; priyom will pull the DR test logs.

Quick answers:
- RTO/RPO: Hosted API (multi-tenant): target RTO 15 minutes for control-plane failover, RPO near-zero for in-flight token state via KV cache sync; Dedicated pools: RTO 5 minutes for node failover within pool, RPO near-zero; Private/VPC: depends on customer topology, standard config is RTO 15 minutes for control-plane failover with optional active-active (we'll document specifics). We'll include a short table in the package.
- Last full DR failover: 2025-11-01 (scheduled exercise). We will provide summarized logs and pass/fail metrics.
- Runbook excerpt: will provide redacted excerpt showing automated leader-election, cache warm-up, and manual escalation checklist.
- SOC 2 Type II: attached (covers 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31).
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed KMS via cloud KMS integrations is supported for Private; Dedicated customers can opt for KMS isolation. We'll include architecture note and config snippet.
- Data residency: We support region pinning and routing policies by tenant; list of regions will be included.
- Subprocessors: will include the current list and contract references.

Proposed timeline:
- 5 May: Draft package (single-page executive summary + attachments)
- 7 May: Internal review (laura/priyom sign-off)
- 8 May: Deliver to Axia (target)

If that works for you we will proceed. If Axia needs items earlier or wants an offsite call to review the package, we can schedule a 30–45 minute walkthrough.

Attachments (coming): redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf, runbook-excerpt-availability.txt, dr-test-logs-20251101.csv

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FFIEC continuity deep-dive — request for evidence and timelines

Jonas / Laura —

I'll own the DR logs and the runbook redaction. Notes and proposed deliverables for the package: 

- Executive summary (1 page) with RTO/RPO table for Hosted / Dedicated / Private.
- Runbook excerpt (redacted) showing: leader-election, KV cache sync, automated prefix cache warm-up, manual escalation checklist, contact matrix.
- DR test artifacts: CSV with test phases, start/end timestamps, success/failure, observed failover latency (ms), and recovery confirmation steps. I'll scrub IPs and any customer-identifiable tokens.
- SOC2 Type II (attach PDF) + statement of coverage and point-of-contact.
- KMS configuration examples (for Private and Dedicated) and a short note on bring-your-own-key support (BYOK) + HSM integration options.
- Subprocessor list + dated attestation note (we update quarterly).

I suggest we include a short mutual action plan as Sarah requested — I can draft a checklist with owners and target delivery dates. Also recommend a 30-min walkthrough with Sarah and Tim on 11 May (UTC-7) to answer any follow-ups after they review the package.

I'll start redaction today and should have drafts by 5 May.

- Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: dr-test-logs-20251101.csv (partial, redacted)
From: Timothy Holt <tim.holt@axiabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Mellinger <sarah.mellinger@axiabank.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FFIEC continuity deep-dive — request for evidence and timelines

Jonas / Priyom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround plan — that timeline works for Axia. Two quick clarifications before you compile: 

1) For the RTO numbers please indicate whether the metric is measured from client request receipt or from service-control-plane detection; we prefer client-request-to-service-recovery for our scoring.
2) Can you include a short note on change-window rollback procedures (how you revert model-serving config changes that might impact availability)?

If you can include those two clarifications in the executive summary, we'll review on 8–12 May and schedule the walkthrough on 11 May as suggested.

Tim
Timothy Holt
Director, Third-Party Risk Operations
Axia Bank

Related link: DocuSign: /axia/nda/AX-2026-0042 (we will send the NDA for signature separately)
